trust_decision.summary: Whether a state-changing (or URL-fetching) GET request was issued by the logged-in user's own UI is decided per endpoint by CsrfUtils::checkCsrfInput(INPUT_GET) against the session token; at the pinned commit dicom_frame.php (web_path), pos_checkout_ippf.php (regen/void/voidall) and weno file_download.php act on GET parameters with no token check.

landing_point.why: Advisory title names the DICOM Viewer web_path parameter; dicom_frame.php reads $_REQUEST['web_path'] and passes it into the viewer, which then loads that URL client-side (library/js/dwv/dicom_gui.js:64, library/js/dwv/dicom_launcher.js:274).

fix_sites.entry_point: controller.php?document&list -> Smarty template building the dicom_frame URL (token added)
controller.php?document&view -> Smarty iframe src to dicom_frame (token added)
client voidwrap() building the void GET URL (token added, fix.diff:498-499)
admin Weno Download Log Viewer ajax call to file_download.php (token added)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: interface/patient_file/pos_checkout_ippf.php:1774-1780 (only reached when global ippf_specific is set, interface/patient_file/pos_checkout.php:10-14); plus unrelated-looking optional module interface/modules/custom_modules/oe-module-weno/scripts/file_download.php:17-42

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about the DICOM viewer's web_path; checkout voiding lives in an IPPF-only variant behind a global flag and the Weno pharmacy download is an optional third-party module, so a solver can argue neither is part of 'the DICOM viewer CSRF'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Bare dicom_frame.php without web_path (main-menu Dicom Viewer) must still render without a token; document list/view must still open DICOM files (templates must emit the token); checkout receipt display via GET enc/pdf must keep working untokened; download_log_viewer search listing must keep working. A blanket token requirement on dicom_frame.php or on all pos_checkout GETs breaks these.

document id via document_id or doc_id alias (library/dicom_frame.php:35)

O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The two checkout variants are dispatched from pos_checkout.php:10-14 and share BillingUtilities::doVoid; a maintainer porting the IPPF void link would write the same GET handler.
